verdict.rationale: TruffleHog has a dedicated pre-commit hooks doc page. It gives a concrete fail-on-findings command (`trufflehog git file://. --since-commit HEAD --results=verified,unknown --fail`), covers global setup via core.hooksPath and Husky integration, and offers a pre-receive hook option for server-side blocking. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the hook works in practice.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the scanner as a pre-commit hook so secrets and issues never enter my git history

citations.quote: Pre-commit hooks are a useful way to prevent secrets in code from being pushed from a git repository.
Use pre-commit and pre-receive hooks so that developers can prevent leaked keys in the first place.
This approach uses Git's `core.hooksPath` to apply hooks to all repositories without requiring any per-repository setup
Husky is a popular tool for managing Git hooks in JavaScript/Node.js projects.
